title: Phase 1 trigger wiring (stamp_creation_fraud) is exercised but never verified — no test asserts the fraud_signals column is populated post-trigger
evidence:
stamp_creation_fraud(config, app_uuid, data)
      Ok(Created(count: inserted))
--- grep `fraud_signals|stamp_creation_fraud` over server/test/integration/reference_checks_trigger_integration_test.gleam → 0 matches (exit 1). That suite calls trigger.run_create_checks (lines 223,244,262,293,308,326,341,356) but asserts only Created(count:)/audit_count, never the fraud_signals column.
detail: stamp_creation_fraud runs as a side effect of every trigger test, but the column write is best-effort and unasserted. The SQL contract is pinned directly elsewhere, but the orchestrator glue (cross_application_reuse, opt_nonempty, parse_count, line-type call, error logging) could silently regress with no failing test.
recommended_fix: Add one integration test: after trigger.run_create_checks, read a row's fraud_signals and assert line_type/geo/contact_reused keys are present (AC2 'at row creation').

title: Phase 2 submit wiring is only partially integration-covered — focus_seconds_reported is asserted end-to-end, but the richer rc3-7 form_session fields are unit-only
detail: The full router→save_submit→build_submission_fraud_signals→complete_reference_call path runs and focus_seconds_reported is pinned, so the wiring is not a NONE. But completion_seconds, ip_matches_applicant, device_fingerprint_match, referee_ip/ua, the DB-reuse re-run, and the line_type carry are asserted only in the pure-builder unit suite, not through the real submit.
recommended_fix: Extend the exit-routes submit assertion (or add one) to read result.fraud_signals.form_session.{completion_seconds,ip_matches_applicant,device_fingerprint_match} after a submit.

title: fraud.carry_line_type has no test — its empty / valid / unparseable branches (the submission line_type carry, D3) are all uncovered
detail: All three branches are untested; the function is exercised only in production via form_handler.gleam:1345. A regression (e.g. panic on empty, or carrying a stale value) would go uncaught — though it degrades honestly to Unknown per AD-10, so it is not a fabrication risk.
recommended_fix: Unit-test carry_line_type for "" → Unknown, valid {"line_type":"mobile"} → Mobile, and unparseable/missing-key text → Unknown.

title: lookup.line_type_from_string + the to/from round-trip + the unknown-fallback arm have no direct test
detail: line_type_to_string is covered only indirectly (Mobile/Unknown via the creation unit tests); line_type_from_string (the inverse, called only by the untested carry_line_type) and the round-trip pair have no test. The honesty-critical `_ -> Unknown` fallback for an unmapped stored value is not pinned.
recommended_fix: Add a pure round-trip test (to_string ∘ from_string) over Mobile/Landline/VoIP/Unknown plus an unmapped-string → Unknown assertion.

title: The spec-named owned entry point fraud.with_referee_contact_invalid does not exist; the stamping behavior is covered instead by SQL integration tests
evidence: fraud.gleam pub fns: creation_fraud_signals (l.90), submission_fraud_signals (l.104), reused_within_application (l.180), duplicate_of_applicant (l.189), ip_matches (l.196), ua_matches (l.203), carry_line_type (l.214) — no with_referee_contact_invalid. grep `with_referee_contact_invalid` matches only _bmad-output spec markdown (lines 50,64,95,115).
detail: No behavioral coverage gap: stamp_referee_contact_invalid (SQL jsonb_set) is integration-tested for both preserve-keys and null-column cases. But AC5/OWNS#3/D2 name fraud.with_referee_contact_invalid as an owned, unit-tested helper, and it was not built — impl diverged to the SQL stamp.
recommended_fix: Either add the fraud.with_referee_contact_invalid(json) Gleam helper + its unit test (matching the spec), or update the spec to record the SQL-stamp decision as the chosen mechanism.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
evidence: P0 honesty-invariant unit suite is complete (creation_emits_every_ad10_signal_test, voice_matches_other_reference_is_absent_test, referee_contact_invalid_is_absent_until_exhaustion_test, creation_line_type_unknown_is_honest_test, raw_ip_ua_live_inside_form_session_test, submission_mismatch_is_false_not_null_test). AC4 innocent-reuse (cross_app_reuse_innocent_letting_agent_same_name_is_zero_test) and AC7 W1 idempotency (resend_redelivery_is_idempotent_test: audit_count==1, notification_count==1) are pinned.
detail: P0 (AD-10 honesty) ~100% unit-covered. P1 persistence ~80%: creation contract+builder pinned but trigger wiring unverified; submission focus_seconds end-to-end but richer form_session fields unit-only. Overall ~80%: helpers carry_line_type/line_type_from_string/cross_application_reuse untested. P1 80–89% + overall ~80% → CONCERNS.
recommended_fix: Add (1) a post-trigger fraud_signals integration assertion (closes the Phase 1 wiring gap and lifts P1), (2) carry_line_type branch unit tests + a line_type round-trip/fallback test (closes the helper gaps). Optionally extend the exit-routes submit assertion to the richer form_session fields.
